description: Variable-cost ratio test for zhou_Set2_100-10-2_subset50: diesel truck E1 versus electric cargo tricycle E2; lambda=2. Not CNY or a full operating-cost total. Excluded handling/wear/investment rates must not be interpreted as free physical costs.
price_basis: E1/E2 energy ratio inspired by recorded estimate; container coefficient uses fixed case reference transport and demand. Zhou lengths remain benchmark units, not km.

ratio_test.investment_reporting: outside this objective; zero container_price does not estimate actual procurement price
ratio_test.distance_field_note: Legacy km field names are used by the cost schema; scale 1 preserves benchmark distances and does not assert kilometers.
